imperialknights/rules/army_rules/Code Ch:
Condition: Army Faction IMPERIAL KNIGHTS
Timing: end of Read Mission Objectives step
Select: mandatory army Oath for coming battle
- 1 Deed + 1 Quality
- 3 options per part, listed below
- Deed: choose 1, or randomly select 1 using 1D6 and Deed table
- selected Deed: completion requirements as listed
- Quality: choose 1, or randomly select 1 using 1D6 and Quality table
Result:
- your army's models with this ability: selected Quality applied until end of battle
- selected Deed completed for first time: Oath fulfilled
- Oath fulfilled: army becomes Honoured until end of battle
- Oath fulfilled: 2CP gained, or 3CP if Deed and/or Quality randomly selected
- these CP: exempt from Core Rules cap on CP gained each battle round (maximum 1)

Deed options

We vow to lay low the tyrant...
Start of battle
1 CHARACTER model from opponent's army selected
End of a turn: Deed completed if that CHARACTER destroyed

We swear to reclaim the realm...
End of opponent's turn
Deed completed if your controlled objective markers outnumber opponent's

We pledge to reap a great tally...
End of battle round
Deed completed if enemy units destroyed during that battle round exceed battle round number
Destroyed units still counted if subsequently returned to battlefield

Quality options

...with all our martial valour risen over all.
Each selection of this model to shoot or fight
Optionally re-roll 1 Hit roll
Optionally re-roll 1 Wound roll

...and we are eager for the challenge.
This model: +2" to Move
This model: +1 to Advance rolls
This model: +1 to Charge rolls

...yet shall our legacy be unsullied.
This model: +2 to Objective Control
This model: Leadership improved by 1

imperialknights/rules/army_rules/Super-h:
Each Normal, Advance or Fall Back move by a model with this ability
May move through:
- models (not TITANIC models)
- terrain feature sections ≤4" in height
While doing so:
- may move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end the move within Engagement Range of them
- may also move through terrain feature sections >4" in height
If it moved through a section >4" in height, after the move:
Roll 1D6:
- 1: that model Battle-shocked
